description: Start recording the BrightScript debug console (port 8085) to a file, keeping the connection open until roku_console_capture_stop. Output from before the capture (the console replays the previous session on connect) is skipped. Console text is never returned; use roku_console_wait to detect lines. Port 8085 accepts a single client: detach the VS Code BrightScript debugger first.

append.description: Append to the file instead of truncating it

file.description: Absolute or cwd-relative log path. Defaults to ./logs/<YYYY-MM-DDTHH∶MM∶SS>-rokuDevice.log

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

settleMs.description: Discard console output received during this window after connecting (replay of the previous session)

name: roku_console_capture_start
